messages:
alice: Starting deploybot run to enable comet-13b-v2 in eu (change window 22:00-23:00 UTC). I want a conservative fallback ordering and a lockhold if latency > 250ms p95. Pin list: core-search, chat-stream.

deploy-bot: :robot_face: deploy started: comet-13b-v2 -> canary 2% in eu-west-1. Monitoring hooks enabled. Run id: db-1748899999.

ben: Copy. What's the fallback ladder? We should prefer quantized v2 first then v1, then titan-lite. No surprise draining.

carla: Proposed fallback (short):
```
- comet-13b-v2-quant (primary)
- comet-13b-v1-quant (fallback 1)
- titan-7b-lite (fallback 2, cost-saver)
```
Also adding a short-circuit to pin core-search traffic to v1 if any 5xx spike > 0.5% over 5m.

eva: Agree with ladder. For safety: set canary duration = 15m, then 30m at 20% if no regressions. Add perf gate: p95 latency delta <= +25ms vs v1. If breached, immediate rollback to v1.

alice: Sounds good. Add an override to drain canary quickly if error-rate or latencies cross thresholds. Can we have a manual lockhold step before 20%? I want an explicit ack.

deploy-bot: Added lockhold at 5% canary. Awaiting acks from alice or ben to continue.

ben: Ack. I'll watch telemetry. Tagging @sre-oncall for infra signal gating.

sre-oncall: Oncall monitoring in place. If p95 > 250ms or error-rate > 0.5% we'll flip traffic to v1 and notify. Also we set a short circuit at the LB level for EU region.

carla: Noting rollout notes for release doc:
- change window 22:00-23:00 UTC
- canary: 2% -> 5% (manual ack) -> 20% -> 100%
- observability checks: latency p50/p95/p99, 5xx rate, mem pressure, kv-cache hitrate
- rollback triggers: p95 > 250ms OR 5xx > 0.5% sustained 5m

alice: Manual ack at 5% now. Proceed to 20% after 15m if green.

deploy-bot: Promoting to 20% in eu-west-1. Canary window starts.

ben: Seeing slight p95 uptick +12ms at 2% — expected. KV hitrate slightly lower by ~1.2%. Keep an eye.

eva: Adding an automated telemetry check in the run: if kv hitrate drops >5% for prefix 'search-' escalate.

carla: Quick config snippet to control fallback priority in runtime: 
```json
{"fallback_priority": ["comet-13b-v2-quant","comet-13b-v1-quant","titan-7b-lite"], "rollback_policy": {"p95_ms": 250, "error_rate_pct": 0.5}}
```

alice: Good. We should publish this in the release notes (short bullet) and attach the runtimes config.

deploy-bot: Telemetry: 20% canary running 10m. p95 across region = 240ms, error-rate = 0.12%. No infra alerts.

ben: Looks stable. I’ll leave canary to proceed to 100% after the 30m green window unless anyone objects.

eva: One caveat: a small spike in model latency matched a background batch job on infra node id eu-node-37. Noting for postmortem if it recurs.

alice: Proceeding to gradual ramp to 100% with 30m hold at 50%. Keep lockhold manual at 50% to confirm no hidden regressions on heavy search routes.

deploy-bot: Ramp scheduled: 20% -> 50% (30m hold, manual ack required) -> 100%. Lockhold at 50% enabled.

ben: 50% reached. Waiting on alice/ben ack.

alice: ACK to continue. I ran a quick A/B of search latency on pinned routes — within thresholds. Proceed to 100%.

deploy-bot: Promotion to 100% completed. All traffic served by comet-13b-v2-quant in eu-west-1. Run complete: db-1748899999.

carla: Filing release note: "Enabled comet-13b-v2-quant in EU with staged canary and fallback ladder. Rollback triggers: p95>250ms or 5xx>0.5% (5m)." I'll attach the runtime fallback config and a short ops checklist.

eva: Post-deploy obseration: small KV cache coldness effect resolved after ~45m; overall token cost down ~6% versus v1. Will monitor for next 24h.

sre-oncall: No incidents. If anything pops, ping #incidents and escalate.

ben: Nice. Thanks team. :tada:

alice: Closing thread — will follow up with perf graph links in the release notes. Good job everyone.
